codeReview.summary: The commit correctly fixes the reported ordered-slot readiness, unordered sink cleanup, verbosity-zero logging behavior, and join-on-worker-error path, but it still leaves active worker threads running on other early-return paths in parseConcurrentWithSink.

issues.description: parseConcurrentWithSink still uses plain `try` on `allocator.create`, `std.Thread.spawn`, and `active.append` while previously spawned workers remain in `active`. If any of those operations fail after workers have started, the function returns before `joinRemainingWorkers`, `shared`/`output_slots` unwind, and the still-running workers keep dereferencing dangling stack pointers. This leaves the feature incomplete for the broader early-worker-cleanup requirement.

summary: Review failed: the feature fixes the four named Bugbot regressions and adds solid regression coverage, but parseConcurrentWithSink still has an unjoined-active-worker early-return path on task allocation/spawn/list-append failures.
